Thanks for submitting an issue!

Quick check-list while reporting bugs:
-->

- [X] a detailed description of the bug or problem you are having
- [X] output of `pip list` from the virtual environment you are using
- [X] pytest and operating system versions
- [X] minimal example if possible

### Description

I get the following error where a fixture is not recognized when running a simple test with a class scoped, class method, fixture with Python 3.13 and any version of pytest>=8.4.0 (I tested each version going back from 9.1.1 with the same result). I found this while trying to update my tests to avoid the deprecation introduced by PR #14071 as part of 9.1.1. The tests passed for Python 3.9-3.12.

Output of minimal example below from macOS 26.3.1, but my production CI tests also failed for the same reason on GHA ubuntu-latest images.

<details>

<summary> Error from `python -m pytest -svx test_classmethod.py` </summary>

```
================================================================ test session starts ================================================================
platform darwin -- Python 3.13.0, pytest-8.4.0, pluggy-1.6.0 -- /Users/langmm/mambaforge/envs/pytest_classmethod/bin/python
cachedir: .pytest_cache
rootdir: /Users/langmm/scratch
collected 1 item                                                                                                                                    

test_classmethod.py::TestClass::test_sample ERROR

====================================================================== ERRORS =======================================================================
______________________________________________________ ERROR at setup of TestClass.test_sample ______________________________________________________
file /Users/langmm/scratch/test_classmethod.py, line 14
      def test_sample(self, sample):
E       fixture 'sample' not found
>       available fixtures: cache, capfd, capfdbinary, caplog, capsys, capsysbinary, capteesys, doctest_namespace, monkeypatch, pytestconfig, record_property, record_testsuite_property, record_xml_attribute, recwarn, tmp_path, tmp_path_factory, tmpdir, tmpdir_factory
>       use 'pytest --fixtures [testpath]' for help on them.

/Users/langmm/scratch/test_classmethod.py:14
============================================================== short test summary info ==============================================================
ERROR test_classmethod.py::TestClass::test_sample
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! stopping after 1 failures !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
================================================================= 1 error in 0.00s ==================================================================
```

</details>

```

<summary> Test script test_classmethod.py</summary>
